name: Samudra Vasane Devi
text:
समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले ।
विष्णुपत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे ॥
meaning: O Goddess Earth, who wears the ocean as her garment and the mountains as her breast, consort of Vishnu: I bow to you; forgive me for touching you with my feet.
purpose: A prayer to the Earth, said before placing the feet on the ground in the morning.
when: On rising, before stepping out of bed.
